subject: ACME pen-test delta acknowledgement and live check window
messages:
From: Jane Doe <jane.doe@acmecorp.com>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Williams <tom.williams@acmecorp.com>
Date: 2028-06-30T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: delta verification & attestation for pen test findings

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for the remediation summary your team sent yesterday. We reviewed the fixes scoped to the two high-severity findings (auth bypass / session token exposure) and have a couple of asks before we close this out on our side and update our SOC 2 evidence pack: 

1) Can Redwood arrange a narrow delta verification (re-check) focused on the two CVEs listed in your earlier report and confirm they are mitigated? We do not need a full re-test, just a focused verification.

2) We need a short signed verification letter (one page) from the testing party confirming the vulnerabilities were re-tested, the steps performed, and that they are resolved (or any residual risk). This will be included in our SOC 2 evidence folder.

3) Please provide the delta report (high-level) plus any supporting artifacts (PoC snippets, request/response examples) where possible.

4) Preferred windows for us: 2028-07-03 09:00-11:00 PDT or 2028-07-05 13:00-15:00 PDT. If neither works, propose two alternatives.

Attached is our internal acceptance criteria doc for delta checks. If you need access to our staging environment or temporary test credentials, let me know — we can provision a scoped account.

Thanks,
Jane Doe
Security Program Manager
AcmeCorp

[Attachment: pen-test-delta-report-v2.pdf (PDF, 1.8MB)]

From: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jane Doe <jane.doe@acmecorp.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-06-30T11:00:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: delta verification & attestation for pen test findings

Jane — thanks for the clear asks. We can do a focused delta verification and provide the one-page verification letter you requested. Quick notes on scope and process from our side: 

- Scope: confirmatory checks against the two confirmed findings: CVE-Auth-2028-001 (session fixation / token leak) and CVE-Auth-2028-002 (refresh endpoint CSRF). No exploratory testing outside the listed endpoints unless you explicitly approve.
- Environment: we prefer to run the check in your staging cluster; please provide a scoped test account with reduced privileges and an endpoint URL (staging.redwood-acme.internal or a public staging URL).
- Evidence: we'll produce a delta report (2–3 pages), PoC request/response snippets, and a signed verification letter from the testing lead.
- Timing: we can accept either of your windows; 2028-07-03 09:00-11:00 PDT looks best for our pen-test partner.

I've attached our remediation evidence workbook for the fixes we pushed earlier — that should speed verification. Let me know if you prefer the alternate window.

Regards,
Karthik Iyer
Security & Compliance Program Manager
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: remediation-evidence-log.xlsx (XLSX, 120KB)]

From: Tom Williams <tom.williams@acmecorp.com>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Jane Doe <jane.doe@acmecorp.com>
Date: 2028-06-30T12:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: delta verification & attestation for pen test findings

Karthik — thanks for the quick reply. 2028-07-03 09:00-11:00 PDT works for us. A couple of clarifications: 

- Please limit checks to the two affected endpoints only (/api/v1/session and /api/v1/token-refresh). No fuzzing beyond header/parameter verification.
- We need the signed verification letter to explicitly state which test credentials and IP ranges were used.
- Deliverables: signed verification letter + delta report + test artifacts (request/response examples).

We'll provision a scoped staging user (acme_delta_tester) and open access from the IP range you provide. I will share creds in a secure Password Manager entry and post the link here once ready.

Tom
Director, Platform Security
AcmeCorp

From: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>

Date: 2028-06-30T13:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: delta verification & attestation for pen test findings

Thanks — looping in Rishi (eng lead) for operational coordination. Quick operational notes before we formalize the window: 

- Pen-test partner instructions: run non-destructive confirmatory checks only. Confirm reproduction steps are limited to HTTP request/response checks and lightweight token replay attempts. No credential stuffing or brute force.
- Deliver a short delta report with: summary, test steps, before/after evidence, and an attached one-page signed verification letter (include tester name, firm, date, and scope).
- We should also capture one network trace (pcap) and one API trace for our internal audit. If ACME cannot provide PCAP export, please confirm

Tom/Jane: please confirm the staging URL (will need to be reachable from our vendor IPs) and confirm whether PCAP export will be available by 07/03. Once confirmed we'll send IP allowlist and finalize the DocuSign attestation prep.

Onwards — Laura
Laura Bennett
Head of Customer Security
Redwood Inference
